## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Implement a 3-MA
```{r ma-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=10}
ma3 <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  for (t in 2:(n - 1)) out[t] <- mean(x[(t - 1):(t + 1)])
  out
}
ma3(c(5, 6, 8, 7, 9))
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("7", correct = TRUE),
  answer("6"),
  answer("8"),
  answer("NA"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

## Classical decomposition
```{r decomp-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=6}
library(fpp3)
aus_production |>
  model(classical_decomposition(Beer, type = "additive")) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r q2}
question(

  answer("Trend-cycle, seasonal, remainder", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Only AR and MA coefficients"),
  answer("Only forecasts and intervals"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
